stem: In April 2026 Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, had €21,000 of sales and marketing expense. Businesses that subscribed for the first time in April brought €2,500 of new MRR, and cancellations removed €900 of MRR. Gross margin is 56%. Voltmarkt computes CAC payback as sales and marketing expense / (new-business MRR × gross margin). What is April's CAC payback? Give months with 1 decimal.
